name: runchance/rcmaker-php
description: High-performance PHP applications with project initialization, isolated app processes and standalone delivery.
keywords: oneness of fpm and cli mode

suggest.catfan/medoo: Optional stable ^2.6.1; RC adapters keep the bundled fallback and PostgreSQL table-scoped identity handling.
suggest.smarty/smarty: Optional exact stable 5.8.5; pristine bundled fallback, isolated RC template data and PHAR file-resource support.
suggest.topthink/think-template: Optional exact stable 3.0.2; pristine bundled fallback, fresh per-render RC engines and atomic compile-cache writes.
suggest.twig/twig: Optional exact stable 3.30.0 for RC\Helper\View\Twig; not bundled.
suggest.illuminate/view: Optional stable 13.40.0 for RC\Helper\View\Blade; tested 13.39.0 remains supported. Not a full Laravel application.
suggest.overtrue/pinyin: Optional exact stable 6.0.1; RC preserves legacy string APIs and adapts PHAR dictionaries without editing native sources.
suggest.jasongrimes/paginator: Optional exact stable 1.0.3 page-window engine; RC supplies validation, safe HTML and simple/data/JSON contracts.
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: Optional stable 8.1.10+ (8.1.x) IpUtils/HeaderUtils for trusted proxies and multipart parameters; unchanged bundled utilities are used otherwise.
suggest.illuminate/database: Optional stable 13.40.0 Eloquent/query builder; tested 13.39.0 remains supported. Enable RC\Helper\Db\Laravel in bootstrap.
suggest.illuminate/events: Optional stable 13.40.0 for Eloquent observers and deferred transaction events; tested 13.39.0 remains supported.
suggest.illuminate/pagination: Optional stable 13.40.0 for native paginator APIs; tested 13.39.0 remains supported. SDB keeps its RC paginator.
suggest.mongodb/laravel-mongodb: Optional exact stable 5.12.0 plus ext-mongodb; RC document models use RC\Model\MongoDB.
suggest.workerman/globaldata: Optional exact stable 1.0.6 engine; use RC\Helper\GlobalData adapters for bounded, object-free transport.
suggest.mix/database: Optional exact stable 3.0.23 primitives; use the RC PHP 8.5 compatibility API rather than the unmodified native query core.
suggest.mix/object-pool: Optional exact stable 3.0.27; historical pools still require Swoole and do not enable Workerman coroutines.
suggest.workerman/redis: Optional exact stable 2.1.0; queue adapters use callback mode without introducing coroutine requirements.
suggest.workerman/redis-queue: Optional exact stable 1.2.2; RC keeps isolated connections and atomic delayed promotion in its adapter.
suggest.predis/predis: Optional stable 3.7+ synchronous Redis/cache/queue client when ext-redis is unavailable.
suggest.dragonmantank/cron-expression: Optional exact stable 3.6.1; RC preserves second-level rules and day-field AND matching with separate adapters.
suggest.zxf/captcha: Optional exact 1.1.0 slider engine; RC isolates native sessions and supplies its own offline widget.
suggest.gregwar/captcha: Optional external Captcha 2.1.x; the bundled pristine engine is used otherwise.
suggest.symfony/stopwatch: Optional external Stopwatch 8.1.x; compatible Composer sources take precedence over the bundled fallback.
suggest.topthink/think-orm: Optional ThinkORM engine and models (^4.0.51); enable RC\Helper\Db\Think in bootstrap.
